pages.title: Elementary School Cafeteria & Multipurpose Space - International School of Prague
blocks: The new heart of our Elementary programme. This dynamic new space will overcome current limitations and transform how our youngest learners eat, explore, and grow together.

This new building will function as a dedicated dining hub, flexible learning environment, teaching kitchen and sensory space. Thoughtfully designed with sustainability and sensory engagement in mind, this dynamic indoor-outdoor environment is envisioned as a multi-sensory landscape; offering diverse spaces for exploration, creativity, movement, and connection.
Elementary School Cafeteria & Multipurpose Space Features
More than a dining hall, this vibrant space will serve as a central hub for nourishment, learning, and connection.
Dedicated Dining Areas: Purpose-built spaces will integrate mealtime into the school day, encouraging healthy habits, independence, and a sense of community through family-style meals.
Flexible Learning Zones: Café-style environments that are easily adaptable for classroom activities, collaboration, and creative exploration.
Sensory Lab & Teaching Kitchen: Engaging hands-on spaces where students can cook, experiment, and connect learning to daily life.
Spaces for Movement & Calm: Climbing structures, cozy nooks, and a dedicated sensory space will support both active play and emotional regulation, ensuring every learner has what they need to thrive.

Curious to see what the future spaces will look like? Simply scan any of the QR codes on the floor plans below with your mobile device to take a virtual tour and explore the vision for our new learning spaces.

pages.title: Why ISP - International School of Prague
blocks: Founded in 1948, ISP proudly celebrates over 75 years of educational excellence. Looking ahead, we strive to become one of the most impactful and innovative progressive IB Schools in Europe.

Throughout its extensive history, ISP has thoughtfully built a learning culture based on an inspiring mission, curious students, expert faculty and staff, an engaged community, and the drive to provide an outstanding, future-focused education.
Belonging is at the heart of ISP

The ISP community celebrates diversity and inclusivity, with nearly 1,000 students from over 60 different nationalities. Our dedicated faculty and staff team reflects this international perspective, representing 20 countries. Additionally, ISP families are actively engaged in our School Community Association (SCA). Through the SCA, we offer a variety of engaging activities, events, and experiences that foster a strong sense of unity, community, and belonging for all.

All ISP school sections, from Early Childhood Foundations, Elementary, Middle through Upper School, are located in our unique purpose-built campus. This is one of many reasons that we hear incoming ISP parents referring to when choosing ISP over other schools.

The ISP Campus features purpose-built facilities, including state-of-the-art learning spaces, a recently renovated Learning Innovation Hub (aka Library), a technology and design-focused maker space (Idea Lab), a fully equipped sports gymnasium with a climbing wall, basketball courts, outdoor fields, playgrounds and more.
We are currently in the planning phase of an exciting Campus Roadmap Project that will bring innovative new spaces to our campus over the next few years.
These include a cutting-edge Design & Innovation Centre, a new Elementary School Cafeteria, Sensory and Multipurpose space, and a renovation of our existing Central Kitchen and Cafeteria.
City and Forest: The best of both worlds

Set against the backdrop of the picturesque Divoká Šárka nature reserve, just a 20-minute drive from the lively centre of Prague, our campus is easily accessible by public transportation and provides quick access to the forest, a favourite outdoor exploration spot for our children. Prague is often recognised as one of the world's best cities to live in, boasting high safety ratings on the Global Peace Index. This provides our students with ample opportunities to engage and explore beyond our campus.

At ISP, our mission is to Inspire, Engage, and Empower all learners to be Curious, Competent, Compassionate Changemakers. Our commitment to the future of education drives us to align our mission and practices in everything we do.

At ISP, we are clear about what we mean by learning, how that learning best happens, and the kind of lifelong learners we nurture. As a full continuum IB World School, we are proud to offer the Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP), the Diploma Programme (DP) and the Career-related Programme (CP).

Every year our students graduate and successfully move on to universities around the world, such as Oxford, Boston University, Parsons School of Design, and the University of Amsterdam, to name a few. Moreover, our vibrant ISP Alumni network offers graduates avenues to reconnect, attend school reunions, and participate in mixers, fostering enduring connections.

We are proud to attract highly experienced educators, with over 90% having 10 or more years of teaching experience and 75% holding advanced degrees. Most importantly, we recruit educators whose experience and expertise are matched by their compassion, dedication, and desire to inspire our students to become Competent, Curious, Compassionate Changemakers.
